metadata.description: A personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins by Manuel Schurr.

plugins.name: professional-twin
plugins.description: Build and use a personal repository of your professional self — your identity, history, values, and direction — so Claude can help you apply for jobs, prepare for interviews, and reflect on your career.

plugins.name: tutor
plugins.description: A personal adaptive learning plugin. Create a custom course on any topic and study it through guided, expert-tutor-style sessions inside Claude Code.

plugins.name: claude-vps
plugins.description: Run Claude Code on a VPS end-to-end: bootstrap the host, onboard projects, test worktree branches at public URLs, and manage a tmux session grid — with a memory/idle resource guard so the box never runs out of RAM.

plugins.name: running-coach
plugins.description: A personal running coach: pull intervals.icu data, diagnose your fitness arc, find races near you, build training plans calibrated to current fitness, and author + push structured single-metric pace workouts to your intervals.icu calendar — plus manage your workout-template library.
